prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: PRODUCTION PIXEL-ART NPC ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET for a Godot game, not a concept poster.
Input image1 is approved concept reference for the five residents (middle row only); input image2 is current in-game 40x48 resident strip for EXACT native visual size, colors and identities. Create new work animation poses of those SAME five people.
Canvas: exactly 1024 wide x1280 tall, FOUR columns by FIVE rows, twenty cells of 256x256. No margins outside grid. NO drawn grid, labels, frames, floor, shadows, background scenery. Background must be perfectly flat solid key-green #00ff00 throughout all empty space, including holes between limbs; no checkerboard.
Every cell has its figure standing with the midpoint between boots at local (128,230). The figure occupies approx x55..205 and y38..231, same size and foot baseline in all cells. Keep entire tools/props inside cell. Hard pixel clusters at an underlying 48x48-ish game sprite fidelity, clearly stepped silhouette, no smooth illustration, no antialias, no gradient, no glow, no microtexture. 12-16 flat colors: bone-white/cream cloth, charcoal outline and boots, cold grey iron, muted worn leather/tawny browns, tiny flesh accents. Only Mira's brazier has a small amber fire accent. High oblique fixed front-three-quarter view. All figures have adult slender small-game proportions, not chibi.
ROW1 MIRA from concept: cream wrap cap/scarf, brown coat, dark apron, mittens; small portable low round charcoal brazier immediately in front to right, held poker: columns 1 resting poker in brazier, 2 lifting right hand/poker slightly, 3 leaning forward to poke coals, 4 easing back to rest. Brazier fixed position and identical size in all frames.
ROW2 IVEN: brown hood, cream scarf, long brown coat, dark pants, book open in left hand; columns1 reads, 2 right hand writes low on page, 3 right hand turns/reaches page edge, 4 resumes reading. Book remains the same object, no symbols/text.
ROW3 TAREN: cream hood, brown travel coat, rolled dark bedroll at shoulder, dark pants, satchel; cols1 checking satchel, 2 lifts strap with right hand, 3 secures fastening, 4 lowers hand. Bedroll and boots remain fixed.
ROW4 LEIA: dark brown tied-up hair, white scarf over brown sleeves/dark waistcoat, patch of pale cloth in left hand and small needle/sewing implement in right; cols1 sewing with right hand close, 2 pulls thread hand outward, 3 returns hand toward cloth, 4 lowers cloth to inspect. No actual thin drawn thread, just clear arms/cloth movement.
ROW5 OREN: cream cap, grey shirt, dark apron, dark pants, a little iron anvil fixed at right boot and short hammer; cols1 hammer near anvil, 2 hammer lifted to shoulder, 3 bent elbow raised a little higher, 4 strike hammer low onto anvil. No sparks. Anvil and feet absolutely unchanged position/size.
These must be twenty individually drawn coherent action poses, not repeated sprites, not mirrored poses, not translated whole bodies. Purpose is calm subtle lively work loops at 2-4fps. Preserve exact approved character identities, wardrobe, silhouettes, material separation and no added fantasy insignia. No title or letters anywhere.
postprocessing: Declared mechanical crop/key-green/nearest/palette/fixedanchor only via existing ranger pipeline. 20 distinct poses; no new fire/steam paintings. Existing title_life_v01 reused.
